title: Цільові кібератаки UAC-0185 у відношенні Сил оборони та підприємств ОПК України (CERT-UA#12414)

entities.name: MIL.CERT-UA
entities.gloss: The computer emergency response team of the Ministry of Defence of Ukraine.

entities.name: Україна
entities.gloss: A sovereign state in Eastern Europe.

entities.name: Український союз промисловців та підприємців
entities.gloss: A Ukrainian non-governmental organization and business association representing industrial and commercial enterprises.

entities.name: НАТО
entities.gloss: An intergovernmental military alliance consisting of 32 member states.

entities.name: UAC-0185
entities.gloss: A threat actor group, also tracked as UNC4221, targeting Ukrainian defense entities, messaging apps, and military systems.

entities.name: UNC4221
entities.gloss: An alias for the threat actor group tracked by CERT-UA as UAC-0185.

entities.name: Signal
entities.gloss: A cross-platform centralized encrypted instant messaging service.

entities.name: Telegram
entities.gloss: A cloud-based, cross-platform instant messaging service.

entities.name: WhatsApp
entities.gloss: An instant messaging and voice-over-IP service owned by Meta.

entities.name: DELTA
entities.gloss: A Ukrainian military situational awareness and battlefield management system.

entities.name: ТЕНЕТА
entities.gloss: A Ukrainian military communications and information system.

entities.name: Кропива
entities.gloss: A Ukrainian proprietary combat tactical management system for artillery and intelligence units.

entities.name: Сили оборони України
entities.gloss: The unified military defense forces of Ukraine.

entities.name: MESHAGENT
entities.gloss: A remote management agent software misused by threat actors for remote command and control.

entities.name: ULTRAVNC
entities.gloss: An open-source remote administration and screen-sharing tool.

entities.name: mshta.exe
entities.gloss: A legitimate Microsoft Windows utility used to execute Microsoft HTML Application files.

entities.name: лист_02-1-437.lnk
entities.gloss: A malicious Windows shortcut file that initiates an infection chain by executing an HTA script.

entities.name: start.hta
entities.gloss: An HTML application file containing malicious JavaScript code to launch PowerShell commands.

entities.name: Front.png
entities.gloss: A malicious ZIP archive disguised as a PNG image containing dropper scripts and executables.

entities.name: Main.bat
entities.gloss: A batch script that executes persistence and cleanup operations during the infection.

entities.name: Registry.hta
entities.gloss: An HTA file placed in the Windows Startup folder to maintain persistence and launch payloads.

entities.name: update.exe
entities.gloss: An executable payload classified as the MESHAGENT remote management program.

entities.name: gnv.exe
entities.gloss: An executable component corresponding to ULTRAVNC remote access tool.

entities.name: mititarycua@gmail[.]com
entities.gloss: An email address used by threat actors in cyberattack operations.

entities.name: device.redirecl[.]com
entities.gloss: A malicious domain used to host HTA files and shortcut payloads.

entities.name: mail.outloolc[.]com
entities.gloss: A spoofed domain used to distribute malicious archives and decoy documents.

entities.name: svc.odwebp[.]com
entities.gloss: A malicious domain hosting MESHAGENT command and control endpoints.

entities.name: uspp.derzhposluhy[.]com
entities.gloss: A spoofed domain impersonating the Ukrainian League of Industrialists and Entrepreneurs.

relations.head: UAC-0185

relations.head: UAC-0185

relations.head: UAC-0185
relations.evidence: отримання несанкціонованого віддаленого доступу до ЕОМ співробітників підприємств оборонно-промислового комплексу, а також Сил оборони України
